title: Signal Orchard
hero_description: a bright ivory maintenance fox in a cobalt raincoat with a glowing antenna tail
story_premise: A storm scattered the orchard's artificial seeds before their migration signal could transmit.
theme_thread: Collecting the scattered lights physically rebuilds the orchard's lost message.

levels.name: After the Static
levels.description: a midnight geometric orchard of indigo trees, wet copper paths, and distant relay towers
levels.outro_beat: The final seed joins the chorus. Far beyond the rain, another orchard answers.
levels.pressure_notes: Spread twelve pickups across opposite map extremes so the closing route is longest.

art_style: clean luminous storybook pixel art with indigo shadows and amber circuitry
audio_mood: hopeful electronic rain with a rising pulse

key_item.description: a tiny amber glass seed containing a sharp radio-wave glyph
